content.comment_body: Good morning, this forum has been very helpful! I previously posted about implementing an analog watchdog with speed represented as frequency [url]. While developing this, I also came across a post regarding using a counter value with an analog comparator [url]. In my simulation, the up/down counter that should count frequency pulses (as digital input) does not register any counts, even when I set the input frequency to a very low value. Is this possibly related to the PC cycle time mentioned in another thread? Thank you for your support! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user notices that frequency-based up/down counters fail to increment during simulation and suspects this may be due to PC cycle time limitations. The simulation does not behave as expected, especially regarding accurate counting of high-speed digital inputs compared to real hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the simulation environment to reliably emulate actual hardware, particularly the accurate counting of low-frequency pulses in up/down counter logic.
